notes.section_3_seam_resolution: The session-51 accepted QUESTION (BoundaryPlan S11-posture amendment, recorded in f0cf620) is landed HERE: stubs.rs now carries the frozen PUB fields { pub boundary_simple: bool, pub seams_glued: bool } plus the refusing try_new() (the S11 TripleContactNode posture; the CC-000 contract test still asserts the refusing constructor and the no-Default rule). certify_graph_disk consumes boundary.boundary_simple as the frozen verdict. notes.certify_graph_disk_decision_table: The decider is exactly the pre-made table in frozen order: (1) any piece with det_lower.lo <= 0 or non-finite det_lower.lo (require inf > 0; sup <= 0 or straddling 0 is not admissible) -> NoAdmissibleProjection; (2) any piece with seam_glued == false -> StarNotEmbedded; (3) boundary.boundary_simple == false -> StarNotEmbedded; else Ok(GraphDiskCert) with the per-piece witness records. No heuristics, no repair, no second chances.
notes.graphdiskcert_shape: The S6 spec freezes DiskPiece's three pub fields and certify_graph_disk's two-argument signature but leaves GraphDiskCert's shape a comment, not code. A two-argument decider over caller certificates cannot re-derive the caller's projection direction, so GraphDiskCert carries the per-piece witness records and the winning projection w lives on search_projection's Ok((w, pieces)) return (consumers attach it to their own ledger). This is the only self-consistent reading of the frozen signature set.
notes.spherical_code_table: SPHERICAL_CODE_14 is the 14-point refined octahedron, order-stable and pinned by a test asserting the exact f64 values: the six +-axis octahedron vertices in the fixed order +X,-X,+Y,-Y,+Z,-Z, then the eight octant body diagonals (+-1,+-1,+-1)/sqrt(3) in the fixed sign order (+++), (++-), (+-+), (+--), (-++), (-+-), (--+), (---), each coordinate the exact f64 literal 0.5773502691896258 (1/sqrt(3)). Stop condition (2) is discharged: the normative table IS the deliverable and is written as one pub const with a same-line H-3 marker.
notes.search_projection: search_projection walks the FROZEN normative candidate sequence (tested by projection_candidate_order_is_the_normative_sequence): (1) the area-weighted average patch normal unit(sum area_lower * mid(normal_box)); (2) the two principal control-net directions unit(mean net_u) then unit(mean net_v); (3) SPHERICAL_CODE_14 in table order. For each candidate w, every piece's det_lower is the interval-arithmetic evaluation w dot (S_u x S_v) of the caller-provided per-piece derivative enclosure (fixed coordinate order, outward rounding); the per-candidate projected-boundary verdict comes from the caller's discharge closure; certify_graph_disk decides. Exhaustion -> NoAdmissibleProjection; empty piece set -> InvalidInput; unglued seam -> StarNotEmbedded (no projection repairs it). No pairwise patch/patch SSI was written (stop condition 3: that is CC-014's composition).
notes.boundary_discharge: projected_boundary_simplicity discharges theory §1 P3 hypothesis (2) over caller-certified projected arcs: (a) near-diagonal radius - every arc's certified P2 radius (curve_injectivity_radius output over the plane-projected arc) must have lo > 0 (a fold arc carries lo <= 0); (b) a closed single chain over distinct vertices (no self-loops, no two arcs sharing both endpoints, one in/out arc per vertex, one covering cycle); (c) planar exclusion - every pair of non-adjacent arcs is strictly separated (boxes disjoint on at least one axis). The square success case computes each arc radius through the real CC-002 curve_injectivity_radius on admitted flat projected-line maps (delta = +inf).
notes.search_input_abstraction: search_projection's per-piece input is AdmittedPiece (normal_box: the per-piece derivative enclosure [Interval;3] of S_u x S_v; area_lower: a certified norm lower bound for the area weighting; net_u/net_v: the mean control-net leg direction hints for candidate family (2); seam_glued). This keeps the certified det evaluation (interval dot against w) inside CC-005 while the full CertifiedSurfaceMap plumbing for candidates over real patch grids remains the caller's certificate substrate - the machine-checked CC-000 graph-disk fixtures carry exactly this DiskPiece-shaped interval/bool data.
